principle: DESIGN AT THE PERIMETER. FUNCTION IN THE CENTRE. (primary visual hierarchy, not absolute geometric separation)
central_field_must_not_contain: AN OBJECT EDGE THROUGH IMPORTANT COPY

focal_anchor.phone: object-fit: cover crops ~86px of a 9:16 plate at 393px. Anchoring LEFT (0% 50%) keeps the quiet left field and pushes a right-side subject to the right edge (100% would pull it ~43px inward). F06 / F13 keep 50% (subject on the centre line).
focal_anchor.tablet_desktop: plates crop vertically there; y focal values apply.

calm_layer.element: <span class="jrn-env__calm"> — the SAME plate as a background image, rendered only on CENTER_STAGE screens
calm_layer.treatment: filter: blur(--jrn-calm-blur) saturate(--jrn-calm-sat) + a bone tint (--jrn-calm-tint)
calm_layer.mask: two feathered linear gradients intersected (mask-composite: intersect) = the safe-zone rectangle; transparent above the chrome and below the field, so the top corners, outer frames and nav band keep the photograph's full detail
calm_layer.feather: 68px phone default (F11 40px, F13 30px), 120px on tablet / desktop

strength_by_class.CENTER_SAFE: blur 3px · tint .08 · sat .92 (F03 F04 F09 F12)

mechanisms.surfaces_for_text_on_the_perimeter: the chrome wordmark and the F04 FILTER control sit on the same paper chip as the controls beside them, so no label stands on beams, foliage or the curtain.

safe_zone_test.method: UI hidden (column, nav, overlays); the rendered background is scored per pixel: 0.55 × local edge energy (Sobel, 9px mean) + 0.30 × saturation above 0.18 + 0.15 × luminance above 0.90 (bright window / sky); hot = score > 0.42.
safe_zone_test.pass_rule: safe-zone core mean ≤ 0.12, hot share ≤ 0.05, and the core calmer than the perimeter

no_paid_generation: Existing authority plates only. Plates that need real recomposition are flagged BACKGROUND_RECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED in JURNL_BACKGROUND_SALIENCE_AUDIT.json.
